prompt: Let $f(x) = 2x + 3$. The machine spits out $19$. What input went in?
hint: The machine does "times $2$, then plus $3$". Undo the steps in REVERSE order.

hints.text: The machine does "times $2$, then plus $3$". Undo the steps in REVERSE order.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Simpler: $2x + 3 = 9$ gives $2x = 6$, so $x = 3$. Undo in reverse — subtract the $3$, then divide by the $2$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check with the table
steps: Try $f(7) = 17$ and $f(9) = 21$ — the output $19$ sits between them.
